Round 17 · The rebuild, measured against the real thing

Look first. Measure second.

R17 turned R16’s refuel road into a refuel base. Fuel tankers, tents and crew now line the runway; the sky clears; and the camera swoops low so terrain fills the frame like the arcade — all three signifiers, landed. The combat framing is proven byte-identical, so the fight is untouched. Stage 13 got its own green biome and the forest was brightened to its measured target. It rises to 8.7. The one tell left is the arcade’s dense tree tunnel walling the runway to the top.
“A clean breadth/polish round — the refuel stage reads as a depot now, not a road: low framing, fuel tankers and tents scrolling past, clear sky. The fight is untouched. The one thing still missing is the arcade’s wall of trees down both sides of the strip.”
